name: AR/XR Chicken Shooter
summary:
not VR - better - AR/XR game. 
Need to keep track of something, but bored? Instead of sitting on your phone or watching a TV series, you can shoot a chicken)
Mixed/Augmented reality. The chicken flies around your REAL room, you need to kill it quickly. Manage to score the required points in the allotted time!

Time game, the speed of movement increases!
